title: [nftcdn.io] Open Source JavaScript NFT Media Viewer/Player (music, video, 3D, etc.)

ms.promise:
・image/png, image/gif, image/webp and image/jpeg viewing integration within the open source JavaScript library
・Video of working example of this capability in practice as evidence for non-technical reviewers
ms.criteria:
・Image files are able to be displayed using the open source JavaScript library
・Video shows the released library's capability with a working example
ms.report:
Outputs:
・Open source JavaScript NFT Media Viewer/Player : https://github.com/nftcdn/media-player
・Video showing its capabilities: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W-vi9lfW2wU

Acceptance Criteria:
・Images files are supported as described in the documentation overview and supported media types.
・The video images section shows how all the expected image formats are supported.

Evidence of Milestone completion
・The library is open source (as proved by its MIT license) and publicly available in the expected GitHub repository.
・The video published on YouTube shows working examples of the library expected capabilities including all expected image types (image/png, image/gif, image/webp and image/jpeg).
